description: Checks for duplicate IPO IDs or duplicate company names
Verifies issue size is strictly positive and non-null
Verifies upper price band >= lower price band and prices > 0
Verifies minimum lot size is a positive integer
Verifies chronological sequence: announcement <= open <= close
Verifies all 4 subscription targets are non-null and >= 0.0
Verifies that category reservation quotas sum to 100% (+/- 1%)
Ensures every record contains a valid source registry ID and URL
Ensures India VIX falls within historical limits (8 to 60)
Verifies all pre-IPO features have timestamps <= feature cutoff
Verifies imputation parameters are fitted strictly on training partition only
